en.description: Turn final manuscript or course text into an audiobook with one consistent narrator. This AI audiobook generator and AI audiobook narration workflow organizes chapters, settles names and specialist pronunciations, shapes long-form pacing, helps choose a suitable audiobook narrator, and creates a representative sample before the remaining book. Use it for manuscript-to-audiobook production, chapter-by-chapter audiobooks, course narration, long-text-to-speech, and sample chapters, with up-to-date price estimates, ordered audio delivery, consistent narrator voice, and focused passage refinements.
en.summary: Turn final manuscript or course text into ordered chapter audio with one narrator, a representative sample, clear pricing, and focused refinements.
en.title: AI Audiobook Narration

zh.description: 把最终长篇书稿或课程讲稿，通过 AI 有声书生成和长文本转语音，按章节制作成有声读物。先整理章节顺序和人名、术语的读法，选择适合长时间聆听的旁白，用一个有代表性的样章试听声音、节奏和音频格式，再按顺序完成其余内容。适合文字转有声书、AI 有声书制作、课程旁白和整本一致播读，并提供当前费用估算、按章节分段交付、音色试听与聚焦片段的读音调整。
